title: Binary subspace splitting data
statement: Let $H$ be a subspace of the $n$-dimensional vector space over $ bF_2$. A binary subspace splitting consists of a finite enumeration of $H$, a natural number $d$, and a linear isomorphism from $H	imes bF_2^d$ to $ bF_2^n$ such that every $(h,0)$ maps to the original vector $h$ in $ bF_2^n$.
